page.title: Settings
page.description: Teammate potions + hand cards: scale, offset, toggle key, and rule-based highlights.
toggleKey.label: Toggle Hand Display
toggleKey.description: Keyboard shortcut to show or hide teammate hand cards. Supports modifier-only bindings and combos.
handContentScale.label: Hand Card Size
handContentScale.description: Scales the mini card previews beside each teammate.
handOffsetX.label: Hand Horizontal Offset
handOffsetX.description: Moves the hand-card row horizontally after automatic placement.
handOffsetY.label: Hand Vertical Offset
handOffsetY.description: Moves the hand-card row vertically after automatic placement.
manualPositioning.label: Enable manual hand positioning
manualPositioning.description: Drag each teammate hand row during combat; offsets are saved per slot.
reserveWidth.label: Reserve original width
reserveWidth.description: Keeps width reserved inside the player info row. Off = pure overlay.
resetSlotPositions.label: Reset dragged hand positions
resetSlotPositions.description: Clears all saved per-slot hand-row offsets.
handRules.label: Hand Highlight Rules
handRules.description: Border highlights for mini cards: text, regex, or template matching.
potionContentScale.label: Potion Icon Size
potionContentScale.description: Scales potion icons beside each teammate.
potionOffsetX.label: Potion Horizontal Offset
potionOffsetY.label: Potion Vertical Offset
potionRules.label: Potion Highlight Rules
potionRules.description: Border highlights for potion icons: text, regex, or template matching.
rule.validation.pattern_required: A text or regex rule must provide a pattern
rule.validation.template_required: A template rule must define at least one condition
runtimeHotkey.toggle.description: Shows or hides the teammate hand card overlay.
